brief:
The International Court of Justice will issue its ruling Thursday on whether Myanmar's 2017 military campaign against the Rohingya minority constituted genocide, Al-Monitor reported. The decision is being closely monitored for potential implications regarding similar accusations leveled against Israel in Gaza.

Myanmar's armed forces launched the operation in 2017, displacing hundreds of thousands of Rohingya from the country. Bangladesh, which filed the case at the court in The Hague, has argued the campaign amounted to systematic genocide targeting the stateless Muslim ethnic group.

title: UN's top court to rule on Myanmar's Rohingya campaign as genocide case
